summary: Full backend + frontend E2E test of ALLUDE INDIA catalogue CMS. Backend: 28 pytest cases across auth, public catalogue, content, dealer enquiries, contact messages, products/categories CRUD + reorder, dashboard stats, media upload/serve/delete, SEO. 25 passed / 3 failed. Frontend: homepage (all 12 sections, hero, 3 collection cards, 3 featured products, footer), navbar Collections dropdown, mobile hamburger menu, collections -> category -> product detail flow (no cart/buy anywhere), dealer enquiry + contact form validation & successful submission, full admin CMS (login incl. wrong-password, all 11 nav sections, product create/edit/delete via dialog, enquiry status update + persistence, homepage content save, category dialog, logout, unauth redirect). All core flows work. 3 real defects found (SEO endpoints unreachable via ingress, email notification 422 undeliverable recipient, blank page on unknown routes) plus minor items.

critical.issue: Defined on the FastAPI app root, so the k8s ingress routes them to the React frontend (returns index.html / platform robots.txt). Verified working on localhost:8001 but NOT reachable on the public URL -> SEO files effectively dead in production. Serve them under /api/... and proxy, or emit static files from frontend/public.

Emergent email API returns 422 'undeliverable_recipient': "We couldn't verify that 'support@alludeindia.com' can receive email". Payload format is correct (probe confirmed); the OWNER_EMAIL mailbox is unverifiable, so NO owner notification is ever delivered. Submissions still succeed (non-blocking, correct). Needs a deliverable OWNER_EMAIL (or delivered@resend.dev in preview) and the 422 body should be logged.

minor.issue: No brute-force protection: 6+ consecutive wrong passwords all return 401, no lockout/429/rate-limit (playbook requirement).
Uses $set merge only, so keys removed by the admin UI persist forever in the content doc (no way to unset). Also no schema validation of the arbitrary `data` dict.
Return 200 {ok:true} for non-existent ids (no 404); silent no-op hides bad requests.
Accepts a raw List[str] body without a Pydantic model and does N sequential update_one calls; unknown ids are silently ignored.
No referential check - deleting a category leaves its products orphaned with a dangling category_slug.
No pagination (hard-coded to_list(1000/2000)); will silently truncate at scale.

ui_bugs.issue: No catch-all 404 route. Any unknown URL (e.g. /no-such-page-xyz) renders a completely blank white page with no navbar/footer.
Only 23 Indian states listed (24 options incl. placeholder); several states/UTs missing (e.g. Uttarakhand/Jharkhand/UTs) for an India-only brand.

issues: State, Business Type and admin category/status dropdowns use native HTML <select> (browser default picker) instead of the shadcn Select used elsewhere - inconsistent with the premium editorial styling
Hero image is a cropped casual streetwear shot (corduroy trousers + denim jacket) - off-brand for 'premium menswear / Crafted for the Modern Gentleman'
Formal Trousers category/product images are full navy SUIT shots although the brand explicitly excludes suits
Social links array is seeded empty so no social icons render (functional, but the site launches with no social presence)

action_items: Expose robots.txt/sitemap.xml so they are reachable on the public URL (ingress only routes /api to backend)
Change OWNER_EMAIL to a deliverable address (email API rejects support@alludeindia.com with 422 undeliverable_recipient) and log the response body on failure
Add a catch-all <Route path='*'> 404 page in App.js (currently blank white screen)
Add login rate-limiting/lockout after 5 failed attempts
Return 404 on delete of non-existent ids; add pagination to list endpoints
Consider replacing native <select> with shadcn Select for design consistency; review hero/category imagery (suits shown despite no-suits rule)
critical_code_review_comments: Root-level routes (/robots.txt, /sitemap.xml) violate the /api-prefix ingress contract - unreachable externally.
PUT /api/content/{key} accepts an unvalidated arbitrary dict and merges with $set; add per-key Pydantic models and full-document replacement semantics.
No rate limiting on /api/auth/login; JWT valid for 7 days with no refresh/revocation.
Category delete does not cascade/validate products referencing category_slug.
email_service.send_email swallows the error body; log resp.text on non-2xx to surface integration failures like the current 422.

success_rate.backend: 89% (25/28 pytest cases; failures = robots.txt, sitemap.xml, login lockout)

seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted: dealer enquiry 'TEST_UI Dealer' (+ API 'TEST_Dealer'), contact message 'TEST_UI Contact', product 'TEST_UI Product'/'TEST_Product', temp category, uploaded test PNG media, temp homepage content key. All cleaned via /app/backend/tests/cleanup_test_data.py; DB verified back to 3 categories / 6 products / 0 enquiries / 0 messages.
test_credentials: Admin alluderetailindia@gmail.com / Prad@9810851309&% - valid, login + Bearer token flow works; token stored in localStorage as allude_token and httpOnly cookie also set.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL + /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Cleanup helper: tests/cleanup_test_data.py. Note testid naming: collections page items are `collections-item-{slug}` (NOT collection-card-*, which is homepage only); admin product rows use frontend slugify output (e.g. 'TEST_UI Product' -> 'testui-product'). Playbook checks verified: bcrypt $2b$ hash OK, httpOnly cookie set on login OK, CORS explicit origins + credentials OK, seed_admin updates password on change OK, brute-force lockout MISSING. Re-verify after fixes: robots/sitemap public reachability, email notification delivery, 404 route.
rca_of_the_issue: 1) robots/sitemap: registered on the FastAPI root app; the Kubernetes ingress forwards only /api/* to :8001, everything else to the React dev server, so requests return the SPA/platform robots.txt. Confirmed backend serves them correctly on localhost:8001. 2) Email: probe of https://integrations.emergentagent.com/api/v1/email/send with the current payload returned 422 {code: undeliverable_recipient} for support@alludeindia.com - the payload schema is fine, the recipient mailbox cannot be verified; enquiry/contact writes are unaffected because send failures are caught. 3) Blank page on unknown URLs: React Router has no path='*' route, so nothing (not even the PublicLayout) renders.
